chapter.title: Fugitives
chapter.note: Rebuilt on 6 November 2026 to the PowerPyx 100% chart (95 boxes, three endings with no icon) and the detroitbecometext template (22 prompts, 16 Alice arrows: 2 large down, 7 small up, 7 small down). LAST STOP → LEAVE BUS → [ FIND SHELTER FOR THE NIGHT ]: the laundromat (STEAL / DON’T STEAL, WEAR CLOTHES or DISTURB MAN, two magazines), the store (the clerk, the register and can stack, three shoplifting pairs, the diversion, the hold-up with its customer, BILLS! and the clerk’s gun, being seen stealing, the TV), the parking lot (the car, the pliers), the squat (two fences, MEET RALPH, fire and bed), the trash collector and ALICE TOO COLD. Endings: ALICE & KARA STAYED IN MOTEL, IN ABANDONED CAR, IN THE SQUAT; the promise, gifts and resting place at each. No probability, public-opinion or instability change. Cross-chapter: the gun from Stormy Night; the shelter, clothes, robbery, Ralph, the fireplace, rA9 and the trash collector for On the Run and Zlatko. Researched in docs/research/ch10-fugitives.md.

decisions.title: Last Stop (checkpoint) and Leave Bus
decisions.context: The bus reaches the end of the line at 10:58 pm; the driver tells Kara and Alice to leave.

options.label: STAY HERE?
options.effect: The driver refuses: the bus goes back to the depot.

options.label: SHELTER?
options.effect: The driver has no idea where they could go.

decisions.gate: Chapter start; only if Kara and Alice escaped in Stormy Night.
decisions.note: The template’s only prompt on the bus; no arrow. LEAVE BUS is unmissable.

benchmark.note: A decision scene with the two buttons; both lead off the bus.

decisions.title: [ Find shelter for the night ]: the street
decisions.context: Free roam in the rain: the laundromat, the convenience store, the motel, its parking lot and the fenced abandoned house, in any order and any number of times.

options.label: TALK TO PARKED ANDROID
options.effect: No answer; no consequence.

options.label: Going too far away
options.effect: “There’s nothing more this way…”

options.label: Do nothing
options.effect: After the trash collector, standing in the rain ends in ALICE TOO COLD.

decisions.note: The chart’s hub; every branch but the three endings returns to it.

benchmark.note: One repeatable scene for the whole chapter’s free roam: the street, every building and every prompt inside them are option sets chosen by where Kara is and which prompt is waiting. TALK TO PARKED ANDROID is offered once; from story 1.9.4 CHECK MOTEL, CHECK SQUAT and WALK ON can be repeated, a repeat restating what still stands in the way, and the street’s situation lists what Kara has found so far (the motel’s $40 and its refusal of androids, the fence and the cutters, the car and the pliers, the clerk’s refusal). WAIT is always offered; its outcome says that time is passing and Alice is getting worse, and the action that leaves one before ALICE TOO COLD says so plainly.

decisions.title: Talk to the android trash collector
decisions.context: Alice sits down at the other bus stop by the garbage truck; a WR600 says he knows someone who can help, on the other side of town.

options.label: TALK TO ANDROID TRASH COLLECTOR
options.effect: Starts the ALICE TOO COLD timer; the address leads to Zlatko.

decisions.gate: Street, any time; PowerPyx: “You are forced to talk to Alice at some point”.
decisions.note: Template “Alice sits at the bus stop”, no prompt and no arrow.

benchmark.note: A street action. After twelve actions without it Alice wants to sit down at the bus stop: it is the only street option left, and in a building only the way out. Sets `ch10TrashCollector` and Kara learns of the address.

decisions.title: The laundromat magazines and the store television
decisions.context: Century “The Bee-Line to Disaster” and Gossips Weekly “It’s Time to Face the Music” on the laundromat cupboard; the Channel 16 report on the first android zoo in the store.

options.label: READ “BEE-LINE TO DISASTER”
options.effect: Bees extinct; robotic bees planned.

options.label: READ “FACE THE MUSIC”
options.effect: Live concerts are coming back.

options.label: Watch TV
options.effect: The android zoo opens; eleven more planned.

decisions.gate: Optional, inside the laundromat or the store.

benchmark.note: One media scene that cuts into the street scene the first time Kara enters each place and returns to it. The old motel-television scene (R10b) is gone: the template puts the broadcast in the store.

decisions.title: Steal clothing?
decisions.context: INSPECT DRYER: clothes for both of them, and the sleeping man’s jacket and cap. Alice: “But, that’s stealing! We can’t do that!”

options.label: STEAL
options.effect: Alice small down. QTE: WEAR CLOTHES (the disguise the motel needs) or DISTURB MAN (they leave with nothing).

options.label: DON’T STEAL
options.effect: Alice small up; the dryer can be opened again later.

decisions.note: Relationship_Stat keeps the up “even if she later does” steal.

benchmark.note: Prompt inside the street scene. STEAL −1 on choosing, with a 0.2 risk (unsourced) for the QTE; DON’T STEAL +1 once. The laundromat closes after WEAR CLOTHES or DISTURB MAN.

decisions.title: How to get the money for a room?
decisions.context: The clerk refuses to help (hostile to an android in uniform; in human clothes he asks “Can I help you?”: NO / HELP). The register is on the counter; the cans are stacked in an aisle.

options.label: USE ALICE AS A DIVERSION
options.effect: Needs NOTICE CASH REGISTER and NOTICE CAN STACK. Alice small down. QTE: STEAL DISCREETLY (money; FACTUAL / JUSTIFY / UNCERTAIN / APOLOGIZE, apologize small up) or TAKE TOO MUCH TIME (caught).

options.label: USE GUN
options.effect: Needs the gun. SINCERE / CALM / AGGRESSIVE, CASH REGISTER, CUSTOMER ARRIVES: STAY or LEAVE; BACK OFF! / TURN AROUND! take the money (Alice small down, then TRUTH > APOLOGIZE small up, or LIE); OPEN THE REGISTER! then BILLS!: CLERK GRABS A GUN, CONVINCE (money, Alice small up) or GIVE UP.

options.label: No money
options.effect: Leave the store; the motel stays closed.

decisions.gate: Store. The hold-up needs the gun from Stormy Night.
decisions.note: Patch 1.06 removed a third option after CLERK GRABS A GUN; none is built.

benchmark.note: Prompts inside the street scene; the arrows sit on the money and on Alice’s question, as in the template. The store closes after any robbery or attempt. Sets `money`, `robbery`, `ch10Robbery` and `ch10RobberyNews` (not after CONVINCE).

decisions.title: Shoplifting, and being seen
decisions.context: Three item pairs: STEAL / LEAVE CHOCOLATE BAR, TOY and WIRE CUTTERS (the cutters once the fence has been seen). One theft is safe; a second is always seen.

options.label: [GUN]
options.effect: Needs the gun. Alice small down; ANGRY / APOLOGETIC / CALM (“get down on the floor”); Kara keeps the items, then TAKE MONEY or LEAVE SUPERMARKET.

options.label: LEAVE
options.effect: Seen at the register: thrown out, the stolen goods lost.

options.label: PUT BACK
options.effect: Seen with an item: thrown out, the stolen goods lost.

decisions.note: The toy and chocolate unlock the gifts; the cutters open the squat.

benchmark.note: Deterministic, as PowerPyx says. One arrow for [GUN] (the template), not the wiki’s second for the register.

decisions.title: Where to spend the night?
decisions.context: The motel ($40 and no androids), the abandoned car in the parking lot, or the squat behind the fence.

options.label: Motel
options.effect: Needs WEAR CLOTHES and the register money: IN THE CAR / FORGOT / NO LICENSE / SAY NOTHING at the desk; room 28.

options.label: Squat
options.effect: Wire cutters (the generator’s pliers or the store’s), either fence, MEET RALPH; leaving closes it.

options.label: Abandoned car
options.effect: BREAK INTO CAR, then STAY HERE (Alice large down) or KEEP SEARCHING.

decisions.note: Each shelter starts On the Run differently.

benchmark.note: Committing to a shelter ends the street scene; the ending events record `ch10Ending` with the chart’s label and set `shelter`.

decisions.title: Meet Ralph
decisions.context: A scarred android with a knife beside Alice: “Visitors… Ralph doesn’t like visitors!”

options.label: ANDROID / LITTLE GIRL / INNOCENT / JUSTIFY
options.effect: First prompt; no effect.

options.label: [GUN] / INSIST / REASSURE / HOSPITALITY / LEAVE
options.effect: [GUN] needs the gun and HOSPITALITY needs its absence; [GUN] is the chart’s THREATEN WITH GUN.

options.label: LEAVE / STAY
options.effect: STAY is FOLLOW RALPH: START A FIRE and MAKE A BED, then TALK TO ALICE; the rA9 carving is optional; LEAVE SQUAT is possible until then.

decisions.note: No Alice arrow on any Ralph option.

benchmark.note: Prompts inside the street scene. Sets `ralph` (met him), `ralphHostile` ([GUN]), `ch10RalphRA9`, and `ch10Fireplace` with the squat ending.

decisions.title: Alice too cold
decisions.context: After the trash collector, about 12 minutes outside: “Can’t go on, Kara… Too cold…” Kara breaks into the car.

options.label: Forced
options.effect: Alice large down; KARA SLEEPS NEXT TO ALICE; ALICE & KARA STAYED IN ABANDONED CAR. No promise.

benchmark.note: The 12 minutes are twelve actions after the trash collector, every choice in the street scene counting one wherever Kara is, and at most nineteen in the whole night; once spent, the first moment with no dialogue waiting ends the search anywhere but the squat’s house. A Kara who never steals or breaks in reaches it within 20 choices. From story 1.9.4 the action that leaves one more says that unless Kara gets Alice in out of the rain now she will be too cold to go any farther. Sets `ch10ColdNight`.

decisions.title: Promise Alice a permanent bond?
decisions.context: At every shelter Alice asks “Why didn’t he ever love me?…” and “You’ll never leave me, right? Promise you’ll never go!”

options.label: PROMISE
options.effect: Alice small up.

options.label: CAN’T PROMISE
options.effect: Alice small down.

options.label: FOREVER
options.effect: The one-button follow-up, “Will we be together forever?”

decisions.gate: Motel, car (STAY HERE) or squat; not after ALICE TOO COLD.

benchmark.note: One promise scene for whichever shelter, then the FOREVER scene. PROMISE is +1 (it was +2).

decisions.title: Gifts and where Kara rests
decisions.context: After the promise: GIVE TOY and GIVE CHOCOLATE if they were stolen and kept; then KARA SLEEPS NEXT TO ALICE or WATCH ALICE FROM CHAIR (motel and squat; the car has only sleeping beside her).

options.label: GIVE TOY
options.effect: “Thanks.” No arrow in the template (the wiki gives a small up; flagged).

options.label: GIVE CHOCOLATE
options.effect: Alice is not hungry.

options.label: KARA SLEEPS NEXT TO ALICE
options.effect: Alice small up (wiki, motel or squat).

options.label: WATCH ALICE FROM CHAIR
options.effect: No change.

benchmark.note: Two scenes: the gifts (only with an item) and the resting place (only in the motel or squat).
